{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Pigton Town |characters=ピグトンタウン |japanese=Pigton Town |image=Pigton Town.png |imagesize=250px |region=Unknown |epicode=HZ036 |episode=Mission: Find Oinkologne's Partner! |colorscheme=Paldea }} '''Pigton Town''' (Japanese: '''ピグトンタウン''' ''Pigton Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive town where many pig Pokémon live. In ''[[HZ036|Mission: Find Oinkologne's Partner!]]'', [[Liko]] and [[Roy]] visited Pigton Town along with [[Dot|Nidothing]] to assist [[Yuno]] with her {{p|Oinkologne}}, who was having trouble pairing up with other Pokémon for the upcoming [[Pigton Town Multi Battle Tournament]].
